 Anwar Tasks Selangor Agencies With Tackling Recurring Floods
 12/11/2026 08:59 PM 
 Credit: FB Anwar Ibrahim 
 Credit: FB Anwar Ibrahim 
 Credit: FB Anwar Ibrahim 
 KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 12 (Bernama) -- All relevant agencies in Selangor have been directed to identify high-risk areas and expedite the clearing of clogged drainage as part of efforts to reduce the risk of recurring floods in the state, said Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim.
 He said relevant agencies had also been directed to strengthen water-level monitoring and early warning systems, and to ensure flood mitigation projects were carried out as planned.
 In a Facebook post, Anwar said he issued the instructions while chairing the Selangor Special Flood Disaster Coordination Meeting today, which also highlighted the need for thorough maintenance of water infrastructure.
 “While chairing the Selangor Special Flood Disaster Coordination Meeting, I emphasised the need to maintain rivers, drains and drainage systems, as well as retention ponds and floodgates, to ensure they remain in good working order,” he said in the post.
 Apart from technical matters and flood mitigation, Anwar, who is also Finance Minister, said the special meeting also reviewed the needs of flood victims, particularly evacuation, temporary accommodation, the supply of essential items, and assistance for affected families.
 “Ensuring residents' safety, providing assistance and implementing mitigation measures must remain key priorities in reducing the risk of repeated flooding,” he said.
